resolutions.finding: PM compatibility required task_id aliases and traces[].req_id in the sidecar.
resolutions.resolution: Added task_id and traces arrays to all ten tasks while preserving validator-compatible id and req_ids fields.

resolutions.finding: PH-007 smart_search before import/adoption made link-filter behavior depend on a later identity workflow.
resolutions.resolution: Swapped PH-007 to Import And Adoption and PH-008 to Smart Search; updated phase dependencies, task details, coverage, risks, and checklist.

resolutions.finding: File ownership was too broad and could cause needless edits to generated or overloaded modules.
resolutions.resolution: Moved Wave 2 work into dedicated modules such as redaction.js, source-ledger-store.js, indexing-service.js, hnsw-index.js, smart-search.js, linked-import.js, and legacy-adoption.js, keeping existing files as adapters.

resolutions.finding: Generated mcp-server.bundle.mjs was listed as a direct edit target.
resolutions.resolution: Removed the generated bundle from direct task files and kept regeneration only through npm run bundle:mcp.

resolutions.finding: HNSW native packaging risk was detected too late.
resolutions.resolution: PH-004 now includes lazy import, degraded-load checks, bundle exclusion, rebuild/asarUnpack handling, and package smoke coverage.

resolutions.finding: Red phase could pass for the wrong reason if test:wave2 was missing or failed on syntax.
resolutions.resolution: PH-001 DoD now requires the script to exist and each contract file to fail on expected Wave 2 assertion signatures.

resolutions.finding: DR-DOC-013 and CON-DOC-007 had weak direct TDD traces.
resolutions.resolution: Added direct PH-007 contract test cases for DR-DOC-013 duplicate/source identity and CON-DOC-007 bounded traversal/no-MCP-import policy.

resolutions.finding: Broken-link wording could drift from canonical FR-TREE-009 statuses.
resolutions.resolution: Research wording and plan tasks now use canonical non-resolved diagnostics; only resolved links can rank or satisfy linked filters.

resolutions.finding: md_sha256 manual-record was weak drift evidence.
resolutions.resolution: Recorded a normalized sha256-excluding-md_sha256 value in the plan and sidecar.

resolutions.finding: sidecar_path was ambiguous for validator canonicalization.
resolutions.resolution: Set the frontmatter sidecar_path to the same-directory filename expected by the validator.

remaining_risks.risk: Implementation still needs code-level verification through kiwi-pm and kiwi-review-fix-loop.
